annotation.justification: The clause is clear and unambiguous. It specifies that a client must treat a PUSH_PROMISE frame with a Push ID larger than what the client has advertised as a connection error of type H3_ID_ERROR. There is no ambiguity in the language or in the conditions under which the error must be triggered.
